tools.name: kimo_apply_ops
tools.title: Edit with typed ops
tools.description: The only way to edit. Ops apply in order, all or nothing, as one undo step. Name new nodes with key, then use @key later in the call. New layers per call: at most 40 (150 when streamed), a ceiling: one finished section per call, no empty frames to fill later. Fix data.problems next. Pass baseRevision from your last result. A failed call returns retryId: send {docId, retryId, edits} instead of the whole call.

tools.name: kimo_script
tools.title: Build with a script
tools.description: Builds with a short sandboxed JavaScript program compiled to kimo_apply_ops ops: one undo step, the same checks, results and limit. Prefer it for building (loops and helpers keep calls short; layers appear as you write); kimo_apply_ops for a few precise edits. A failure names the line and returns retryId: send {docId, retryId, edits} to patch the code. Guide: script.

docId.description: Document id (d_…) from the turn context, kimo_get_state or kimo_open.

code.description: JS. Insert(parent, node, index?) → ref (parent: "root", id or ref; node: an insert body, may have children: [nodes]); Update(ref, set, unset?); Move(ref, parent, index?); Delete(ref); Copy(ref, parent, set?) → ref; Instantiate(component, parent, {name?}) → ref; Op(kimo_apply_ops op) → ref; Get(id), Children(id|"root") → nodes before the script (fields, children, box); Print(…). Top-level names persist to your next script.
